agent_explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes; failure is driven by sensor_noise=0.015 with dt~0.015. Noisy angle measurement corrupts the state-feedback controller, causing growing oscillations: controller applies large forces (~+40 N) but cart velocity and pole angular rate diverge (v=-8.05 m/s, omega=10.07 rad/s at step 43), driving theta from 0.44 rad at step 40 to 0.86 rad at step 43 exceeding 0.8 limit. Removing noise while keeping all other parameters identical stabilizes the system.
